errors.evidence: The description incorrectly generalizes the axes for both charts. There are two charts, each with its own x and y axis. The x-axis of the left chart is '音频时长/秒' (audio duration/seconds) and the x-axis of the right chart is '文本长度/字符' (text length/characters). Both y-axes represent counts ('对应音频个数' and '对应文本个数'), not '文本文本/字数' (text/word count).

The description incorrectly combines the x-axis ranges of the two separate charts. The left chart's x-axis categories range from '0-5' to '35-40', while the right chart's categories range from '1-20' to '140-160'.
